name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message in the flow of the page, with an optional status.
use: A message about the page or the task it sits in, which stays until the condition is gone: a notice, a warning before something goes wrong, a failure. Choose the status by what the reader has to do and say it in the words as well. An alert that appears after the page has loaded needs role="status", or role="alert" for a failure that needs action now; one that is in the page from the start needs no role.

instead.when: It confirms something that just happened and may be missed
It concerns everyone on the page and runs across its top
The reader must answer before going on
It is the error of one form field
The view has nothing to show yet

classes.name: alert
classes.description: A neutral message: a flat face with a half-pixel contour. A button or a link after the body sits at the end of the row and wraps under the text when the alert is narrow

classes.name: alert-info
classes.description: Context that changes nothing yet: a faint tint and icon in the info hue

classes.name: alert-success
classes.description: Something that just completed: a faint tint and icon in the success hue

classes.name: alert-warning
classes.description: Attention before something goes wrong: a faint tint and icon in the warning hue

classes.name: alert-danger
classes.description: A failure or a blocked action: a faint tint and icon in the danger hue

classes.name: alert-icon
classes.description: Beside icon on the icon: centers it on the first line of text, however many lines follow

classes.name: alert-body
classes.description: Holds the words and takes the remaining width

classes.name: alert-title
classes.description: The few strong words that carry the message

classes.name: alert-description
classes.description: The sentence under the title, or the whole message of an alert without a title

example:
Your card expires this month

Update the payment method to keep deployments running.
